subject: Using subset for model selection in MuMIn package

messages.author: 0141b24755b40cf8
messages.subject: Using subset for model selection in MuMIn package
parts:
Hi all,

Is it possible to use the subset flag in the dredge function from MuMin package for model selection? I have tried a variety of methods to get it to work, to no avail.

Here is some sample code. Suppose I only want to include the observation covariates date .

library(unmarked)
library(MuMIn)
data <- read.csv(system.file("csv", "widewt.csv", package = "unmarked"))
y <- data[ ,2:4]
siteCovs <-  data[ ,5:7]
obsCovs <- list(date = data[ ,8:10],ivel = data[ ,11:13])
umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y = y, siteCovs = siteCovs, obsCovs = obsCovs)

fm <- occu(formula = ~ date + ivel + forest ~ forest + elev + length,data = umf)

mod_dredge <- dredge(fm, beta = F, evaluate = T, rank = AIC) ## This works

but . . .

mod_dredge <- dredge(fm, beta = F, evaluate = T, rank = AIC, subset = !(date))

doesn't work. I have also tried the following.

mod_dredge <- dredge(fm, beta = F, evaluate = T, rank = AIC, subset['date'] == FALSE)
mod_dredge <- dredge(fm, beta = F, evaluate = T, rank = AIC, subset = ~ date)
mod_dredge <- dredge(fm, beta = F, evaluate = T, rank = AIC, subset = expression(date))

I searched through the message board and couldn't find any questions related to this.

If it isn't possible, can you subset after using dredge()?

Thanks for any information.

messages.author: 0141b24755b40cf8
messages.subject: Re: Using subset for model selection in MuMIn package
parts:
Hi all,

The key is to use the names from the dredge function, so it isn't "date", it is "p(date)". This code works:

mod_dredge <- dredge(fm, beta = F, evaluate = T, rank = AIC, subset = !("p(date)"))

You can get the names by running the global model with dredge, but remember, the dredge function truncates some of the names. So "p(date)" becomes "p(dat)". Use the untruncated names.
